name: Wihwado Retreat
title: Wihwado Retreat
summary: The 1388 episode in which General Yi Sŏng-gye of the Goryeo dynasty was ordered to march north with his army and invade the Liaodong Peninsula, but instead decided to turn back to Kaesong and stage a coup d'état.가 General Yi Sŏng-gye had gained power and respect during the late 1370s and early 1380s by pushing Mongol remnants off the Korean Peninsula and also by repelling well-organized Japanese pirates in a series of successful engagements.
